sources.title: Nace AI Open-Sources Drex 1.5, a 9B Decision Model for Ranking Options
sources.snippet: Nace.AI has open-sourced Drex v1.5, a 9-billion-parameter model that doesn't write text at all — it scores the options you give it. Instead of generating a sentence, it takes a question with a fixed set of answer choices and returns a probability for each one, which makes it a tool built for ranking and deciding rather than conversing.
